notes: Linux only: on Windows Go itself skips these two through the same MustHaveDebugOptionsSupport guard, so both runtimes skip identically there and the Windows row stays 8 matched / 0 disclosed; this entry fires only where Go's side runs them.

disclosures.name: TestDisableAllCapabilities
disclosures.signature: skipping test: cpu feature options not supported by OS
disclosures.reason: Capability-detection divergence (board class W6, coordinator-ruled platform-skip 2026-08-27 at the Linux bank, roster commit 030f9e783). Go on Linux re-executes the test binary with GODEBUG=cpu.all=off and checks that internal/cpu reports every feature disabled; the converted host takes Go's OWN skip branch, MustHaveDebugOptionsSupport, and skips with that upstream text. Amended 2026-09-28 (C4 AESHASH): the original premise, that the managed runtime cannot disable x86 capabilities, no longer holds. internal/cpu now registers doinit's option table and applies GODEBUG's cpu.* options off Windows (cpu.all=off zeroes every flag the table names). The remaining gate is DebugOptions: Go's cpuinit sets it true on Linux, and nothing sets it here because cpuinit never runs. The bank captured the signature from the run but committed the roster line only; this manifest is that bank's missing artifact, added 2026-09-03 when the Linux leveling re-sweep at 22d2bd9dc read the row 6 matched + 2 unabsorbed and the roster guard gained the line that every disclosed count must be backed by a committed manifest.

disclosures.name: TestDisableSSE3
disclosures.signature: skipping test: cpu feature options not supported by OS
disclosures.reason: Same mechanism as TestDisableAllCapabilities with GODEBUG=cpu.sse3=off: Go on Linux runs it, the converted host takes MustHaveDebugOptionsSupport's own skip and skips with the upstream text. Amended 2026-09-28 (C4 AESHASH): cpu.sse3=off now clears HasSSE3 off Windows through the same option table, so the remaining gate is DebugOptions, which Go's cpuinit sets true on Linux and nothing sets here. Board class W6, platform-skip as ruled 2026-08-27; manifest committed 2026-09-03 alongside its sibling entry.
